snippet.title: Cosmula 1.0 Trailer
snippet.description:
The Cosmula 1.0 Update is out now on Steam!
Engage in an intense space shooter that you can play in single-player or multiplayer with up to 6 players. Play a variety of different spaceships, each with their own unique stats, components, and playstyles!
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2421520/Cosmula/
